AUM ₹1.43 lakh cr (+21%), SIP book +17%, OPM 23→26%, no dilution. Priced for excellence: ~2x in 5 yrs, not 5x.
Kill criteria: SIP book growth <10%; OPM <23%; net equity sales falling 2 qtrs; adverse SEBI trail action
Caveat: sourced from public screens — no proprietary edge (lesson L1). Pledges not confirmed from NSE SAST.
